rows.synopsis: When new Doozertubes are delivered to each Fraggle's cave, they're able to come together for a song even though they're apart.
rows.situation: trying something new that feels scary; not trusting a strange new gadget; staying connected with friends even when you are apart
rows.notes: Script-verified: Gestdown English subtitles (SuperSubtitles, 1080p, showId 032V1d7XKDlzjH8X4VCJ7k, TMDB 102318), sourced live this session; content-checked against catalog synopsis (identity keywords verified). Who learns: Boober learns the Doozertube is a way to be together even when apart (All right. I'll talk is his small first step, and he keeps his distance while trying it), and the Fraggles learn connection survives distance. Emotion: nervous/worried is Boober's wariness of the strange device (I'm not getting any closer to that thing); happy the shared song. Coping: trying again: Boober's turn is taking the small step after reassurance, and the step grows (he ends ready to do it again in 20 seconds). Age 2-4 on TV-G, five-minute, gentle-music evidence; vibe calm on the episode's own tone. Accepted-copy fix-in-place 2026-11-19, per Allie ruling todo_yv3UTHmI

rows.episode_title: The Cave of the Silly Creatures
rows.synopsis: Uncle Travelling Matt uses a Doozertube to share his latest exciting adventure in Outer Space—exploring the cave of a Silly Creature.
rows.situation: exploring a strange new place; wanting to make a connection when everything is unfamiliar; keeping friendly until the connection lands
rows.notes: Script-verified: Gestdown English subtitles (SuperSubtitles, 1080p, showId 032V1d7XKDlzjH8X4VCJ7k, TMDB 102318), sourced live this session; content-checked against catalog synopsis (identity keywords verified). Who learns: Uncle Travelling Matt learns that charm, cleverness and steady friendliness open even an impenetrable entrance (I made friends with the hairy monster), and Gobo learns his uncle's adventures are real and shareable. Emotion: silly carries the misread household (guard monster, claw creature, cold ovens for growing space vegetables); happy lands when the connection he wanted arrives. Coping: trying again: every first try fails (the entrance, the squishy boulder, the too-small cave) and Matt adapts until the friendship works. Age 2-4 on TV-G, five-minute, gentle-music evidence; vibe silly. Topics: none of the nine buckets fits an exploring-and-friendship story, left empty per the guide. on the episode's own tone. Synopsis em dash kept verbatim per the quoted-source exception. Accepted-copy fix-in-place 2026-11-19, per Allie ruling todo_yv3UTHmI

rows.synopsis: Gobo brings all the Fraggles together on their Doozertubes to show off their talents, but Wembley can't decide what to do.
rows.situation: feeling left out when everyone shows what they can do; not knowing which choice to make; finding your own thing to share
rows.notes: Script-verified: Gestdown English subtitles (SuperSubtitles, 1080p, showId 032V1d7XKDlzjH8X4VCJ7k, TMDB 102318), sourced live this session; content-checked against catalog synopsis (identity keywords verified). Who learns: Wembley learns there are all sorts of talents and everyone has something special to share, even little you (Uncle Matt's words he acts on), and the Fraggles learn waiting for a friend is part of the show. Emotion: lonely catches Everyone except for me (left out, the guide's left out routes to lonely); proud lands when both pickle and radish balance. Coping: reframing/distraction: Uncle Matt recasts I have no talent into everyone has something special, and Wembley acts on the recast by inventing his own act. Age 2-4 on TV-G, five-minute, gentle-music evidence; vibe silly on the episode's own tone. Accepted-copy fix-in-place 2026-11-19, per Allie ruling todo_yv3UTHmI

rows.synopsis: Uncle Travelling Matt's adventures in Outer Space lead to Gobo, Red, and the Fraggles connecting with special musical guest Common.
rows.situation: making a new friend you have never met in person; reaching out when someone new shows up; finding connection through making music together
rows.notes: Script-verified: Gestdown English subtitles (SuperSubtitles, 1080p, showId 032V1d7XKDlzjH8X4VCJ7k, TMDB 102318), sourced live this session; content-checked against catalog synopsis (identity keywords verified). Who learns: Gobo and Red learn a stranger on the Doozertube is a friend before he is a name (Common Fraggle), and Common learns music creates connections and has the power to bring us all together (his own words). Emotion: happy carries the jam session; calm sits in the easy back-and-forth of two strangers becoming a band. Coping: talking it out: the move is reaching out (is anyone there, can you hear me) and the conversation becomes a song; tagged as the nearest term because the reaching-out happens through music, flagged for vocabulary review. Age 2-4 on TV-G, five-minute, gentle-music evidence; vibe energetic on the episode's own tone. Accepted-copy fix-in-place 2026-11-19, per Allie ruling todo_yv3UTHmI

rows.synopsis: When the Doozers set up a Doozertube at the farm of special musical guest Jason Mraz, he joins Gobo and Wembley for a jam session.
rows.situation: having a hard time making up your mind between two things you like; feeling torn over a small decision; learning deciding can be fun with friends
rows.notes: Script-verified: Gestdown English subtitles (SuperSubtitles, 1080p, showId 032V1d7XKDlzjH8X4VCJ7k, TMDB 102318), sourced live this session; content-checked against catalog synopsis (identity keywords verified). Who learns: Jason Mraz learns a word for his own indecision (to wemble means having a hard time making up your mind) and that the fun part is not knowing what to decide while having fun with friends, and Wembley learns his wembling is something to love. Emotion: confused is Jason's avocado-or-kumquat tornness; happy the jam and the wembling song. Coping: naming the feeling: naming the state out loud is the story's modelled move (Wembley names wemble, Jason answers That I understand) and it drives the resolution, since Jason then enjoys deciding and chooses; the shown-mattering test passes. Age 2-4 on TV-G, five-minute, gentle-music evidence; vibe silly on the episode's own tone.

rows.synopsis: The Fraggles are joined by Neil Patrick Harris, Tiffany Haddish, Ziggy Marley, Alanis Morissette, and more special guests for an epic jam session.
rows.situation: feeling cooped up and needing to move; hesitating when a big loud group thing is proposed; a dance party that brings old friends and new together
rows.notes: Script-verified: Gestdown English subtitles (SuperSubtitles, 1080p, showId 032V1d7XKDlzjH8X4VCJ7k, TMDB 102318), sourced live this session; content-checked against catalog synopsis (identity keywords verified). Who learns: Neil Patrick Harris learns to say what he needs (I feel so cooped up becomes the biggest dance party ever), and Boober learns a sit-and-focus Fraggle can still join a big party when a friend names the feeling and the group answers. Emotion: happy and silly carry the guest lessons (rock hockey, radish breathing, watermelon bongos) and the finale. Coping: naming the feeling: Neil names cooped up out loud, Boober relays it, and the Fraggles act on the name with the party, so the shown-mattering test passes. Age 2-4 on TV-G, five-minute, gentle-music evidence; vibe energetic. Rock hockey is a minor guest beat under Sports & games; the two strongest buckets are tagged. on the episode's own tone.
